name: Sonomi
message: 「…Tch, how annoying.」
She roughly wiped the blood that had trickled down onto her forehead.
Looks like she’d been slashed in the head or somewhere else.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Suzakuin Momiji… she was more interesting than I thought.」
Seeing as she was a young lady of the Suzakuin Family, she expected her to fight with some refined elegance, but she had actually been quite the brawler.
It would’ve been even more fun if the teacher hadn’t gotten in the way, but well, I’ll settle for that this time.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Heh, don’t know how serious she was being, but this makes me look forward to the Martial Festival…！」
A grin involuntarily spread across her face.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yo, you’re in a good mood, aren’t you, Arakawa?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「…Huh? Who’s that, you?」
It was Sasaki Mikoto who had appeared.

name: Mikoto
message: 「I haven't seen you around lately, so I thought maybe you finally got expelled.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Shove it.」
This woman was the school’s infirmary doctor. When she was a first-year, she’d gotten injured a lot and was well-acquainted with her care.

name: Sonomi
message: 「There just aren't any crowds left who can actually land a hit on me, that’s all.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I see, so you’ve gotten stronger since your first year.」
Sasaki took a cigarette out of her pocket and puffed out a cloud of smoke.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Phew… that hits the spot. Nothing like having a smoke outside.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You’re still a delinquent teacher, aren't you.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You’re not allowed to smoke, got it？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don't be an idiot, I’m a sword-bearer. I wouldn’t be caught dead smoking something that ruins my body.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Splendid, splendid. Glad to hear you’re a picture of health.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Shut up, what 'picture of health.' You mocking me?」
Sasaki chuckled.
This woman was always picking on her, but for some reason, it didn't feel unpleasant.

name: Mikoto
message: 「About the Martial Festival starting next month—do you think you’ll be able to go this year？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Obviously. This is the year I’m becoming the Toujinegi.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That’s something to look forward to.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph… what, you’re creeping me out.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「By the way, you’re still not hanging out with anyone, just doing your own thing？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「What of it? Doesn’t really matter, does it? I like being on my own.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Acting like a delinquent is so out of style these days, you know~」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I ain’t trying to act like a delinquent. It’s just that there ain’t anyone worth syncing up with.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Is that so？ I happened to see you out getting a meal with someone the other day.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If I recall, that was Kazamine Setsugekka from the Takamura Class.」
I wanted to click my tongue in annoyance. Did she really see me with that Chihuahua?

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Quit keeping tabs on what I’m doing, will ya.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Relax, I’m not that bored.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「It’s just that you looked like you were having fun, which is rare, so it caught my eye.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Having fun？ I was just being pestered by her.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Heh, is that right? Rare to see you being the one getting pestered by someone.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hah, tell me about it.」
To think there’s actually someone who’d go out of their way to pester me, calling me cool or whatever, and trying to get on my good side.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Still, I never thought you and a young lady like Kazamine would hit it off.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「A young lady...？ Is she loaded？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「What, you didn’t know? The Kazamine family is one of the wealthiest in the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.」
...Huh, so that’s how it is.
In short, she’s just a rich young lady who’s lived a life of luxury and wanted to play pretend with being a bad girl.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Tch, what a boring story.」
I thought she might have some potential, too. What a letdown...！

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oops, did I say too much?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Nah, not at all.」
Better that than hanging out with her like some clueless fool. That’d make me nothing but a clown.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Look, Arakawa. Kazamine Setsugekka carries her own share of things she can't tell anyone, too. Just like you.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You mean to say a rich girl has suffered just as much as I have？ No way that’s possible...！」
I’ve done whatever it took to put food on the table for my younger siblings. I’ve endured no matter how much unreasonable garbage I’ve been put through.
I’ll never forget the anger, the sorrow, and the humiliation of those times.

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’ll tell you something: I absolutely hate those martial arts family types.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「They ain’t even that strong, but they act all high and mighty because of their ancestors’ names. It makes me sick, I swear.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Then why on earth are you doing Jindou？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That’s obvious, ain’t it?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「As long as I’m within the rules of Jindou, I can beat those martial arts family types to a pulp as much as I want.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Getting knocked flat on their asses by an outsider like me, on a stage they set up themselves, and being unable to even stand back up.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That’s just insanely fun to watch…！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Haha, that is amusing, I’ll give you that.」
As she said this, Sasaki put away her cigarette.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, go ahead and do as you please. I’m rooting for you.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hmph, ‘rooting for me,’ huh…」
I really don’t get this Sasaki person. Setsugekka is the same way, I have no idea what they get out of hanging around me.

name: Sonomi
message: 「What do you even live for, anyway？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If I had to say, I hate dealing with troublesome things. Running around doing all that work myself just doesn’t suit me.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「That’s why I’m happy to have a hothead like you running wild and making my boring days a little more entertaining.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「In that sense, you’re a real prospect. Do your best to entertain me.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ha, you’ve got twisted tastes. I can’t keep up with you.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I’d say the feeling is mutual.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ain’t that the truth.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Alright then… shall we go, Arakawa?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh? Go where?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「You’re injured, aren’t you? That cut on your head—if you don’t get it stitched up, the bleeding won’t stop.」
Right as she said it, blood started dripping down my forehead again.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch… yeah, yeah, I got it.」
